title: Ind.3 delayCountWl: RangeError (not TypeError) for BigInt/circular input (C5)
context: Follow-up from the T-02 review (merged). Clarification C5 (binding): any non-string input is a RangeError. In src/indicators/delayCount.mjs the error message uses JSON.stringify(option), which itself throws TypeError for BigInt (1n) and circular objects, so delayCountWl(1n) / delayCountWl(circular) raise TypeError. Fix: format the offending value safely (e.g. try { JSON.stringify } catch { String/typeof fallback }), keep the message containing the value and the allowed list. Add unit tests first: delayCountWl(1n) and a circular object throw instanceof RangeError. Do not change behaviour for any other input; do not edit package.json or files outside scope.
acceptance: (AC-8, C5) delayCountWl(1n) throws instanceof RangeError (not TypeError)
(AC-8, C5) delayCountWl(o) with a circular object o (o.self = o) throws instanceof RangeError
(AC-6..9) all existing unit and integration tests still pass unchanged
